description: Dependency updates. OpenFGA server and fga CLI pins move together in one PR (scripts/check-versions.sh fails otherwise).

customManagers.description: OpenFGA server: versions.env (the unikernel Dockerfile and the compose files use the dockerfile and docker-compose managers)
fga CLI: versions.env, CI and flake.nix
pg_ukc_scaletozero (Unikraft's scale-to-zero PostgreSQL extension): the commit the Postgres image builds, updated to the latest commit on its stable branch

packageRules.description: Unikernel images change what gets deployed: cicd, which takes no path scope
The Postgres image checks every download's SHA-256, so a version or extension bump needs its checksum too
prBodyNotes: The Postgres image pins its downloads by SHA-256. For a `PG_VERSION` bump, set `PG_SHA256` to the checksum published at `https://ftp.postgresql.org/pub/source/v<version>/postgresql-<version>.tar.bz2.sha256`; for a `PG_UKC_SCALETOZERO_COMMIT` bump, set `PG_UKC_SCALETOZERO_SHA256` to `curl -fsSL https://github.com/unikraft-cloud/pg_ukc_scaletozero/archive/<commit>.tar.gz | sha256sum`. Until then the build stops at the checksum check. Then run `./scripts/check-postgres-image.sh` (the "Postgres image" workflow runs it on this PR).

packageRules.description: Packages pinned in both api/ and tests/integration/: one PR spans both, so no scope
Server and CLI pins must match (the CLI embeds the server for fga model test); one PR, no scope since it spans several
prBodyNotes: Before merging: update the vendored sources with `git subtree pull --squash` (see `docs/repos/README.md`); for a new fga CLI, update the `sha256` hashes in `flake.nix`; then run `./scripts/check-versions.sh`, the model tests and the integration suite. The fga CLI release must embed the same OpenFGA version as the server.

packageRules.description: A PostgreSQL major upgrade needs a data migration; Node majors change engines and CI. Do these by hand.
